name: Faro
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Sicilian red DOC limited to the commune of Messina. It is made mainly from Nerello Mascalese, Nerello Cappuccio and Nocera, with up to 15% Calabrese, Gaglioppo or Sangiovese.
